page_title: NAP 2-2 GEN | Napoli v Genoa 11/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' David Neres (Napoli) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
90+4' Napoli are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90+3' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Philip Billing (Napoli), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' David Neres (Napoli) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
89' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Philip Billing (Napoli) for his blatant foul.
88' Antonio Conte prepares a substitution. Matteo Politano is replaced by David Neres (Napoli).
84' 2 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Aaron Martin puts the ball on a plate for Johan Vasquez (Genoa), who has an easy finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 2:2.
82' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
80' The substitution is prepared. Philip Billing (Napoli) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Giacomo Raspadori.

79' The most active player in today's match is definitely Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
78' Here is a change. Stefano Sabelli is going off and Patrick Vieira gives the last tactical orders to Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa).
78' Here comes a substitution. Honest Ahanor is given a rest as he is replaced by Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa).
76' The linesman raises his flag. Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is adjudged offside.
76' Romelu Lukaku latches onto a perfect defence-splitting pass from Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) and heads towards goal.
74' Matteo Politano (Napoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

73' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Napoli.
73' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
73' Genoa control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
69' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Vitinha and he is replaced by Lior Kassa (Genoa).
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sebastian Otoa trots off the pitch and is replaced by Mattia Bani (Genoa).
68' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

67' Scott McTominay (Napoli) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the bottom left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Benjamin Siegrist. The ball goes out for a corner. Napoli can continue in their attacking effort.
67' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 11:6.

64' 2 - 1 Goal! Scott McTominay displays great vision and sends a pass to Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the left post. The score is 2:1.
62' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
59' Substitution. Junior Messias will be replaced by Aaron Martin (Genoa).
59' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Napoli, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
58' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Vitinha (Genoa) was quite harsh and Marco Piccinini didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
56' A pass from Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is intercepted by Benjamin Siegrist and the move breaks down.
54' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
53' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

52' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Benjamin Siegrist pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom right corner.
50' The Genoa players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
48' The ball is cleared after Vitinha (Genoa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Now Napoli have a corner.
45+2' Some patient build-up play from Napoli as they look to unlock the defence.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
43' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul.
41' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
39' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) sprays a pass out to Leonardo Spinazzola, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
36' Vitinha (Genoa) tries to find Andrea Pinamonti, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
32' 1 - 1 Alex Meret (Napoli) was unlucky to score an own goal attempting to intercept a cross. Hang your head in shame!
31' Vitinha (Genoa) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick into the box and attempts to score with a header. His effort is not accurate enough and bounces away off the bar.
30' A free kick has been awarded to Genoa.
30' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle. Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) commits a foul after dangerous play.
28' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) commits a foul and Marco Piccinini immediately signals a free kick.
27' Junior Messias (Genoa) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
24' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

24' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Benjamin Siegrist pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Napoli.
22' Good defending. Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) tries to find Romelu Lukaku inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
21' Napoli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
21' Junior Messias (Genoa) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
21' Junior Messias (Genoa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
18' Matteo Politano (Napoli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
15' 1 - 0 Goal! Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) takes a short pass from Scott McTominay in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
13' Stanislav Lobotka has picked up an injury and is replaced by Billy Gilmour (Napoli).
12' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
10' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
6' Great teamplay by Napoli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
5' Matteo Politano (Napoli) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.
4' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
3' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
2' Sebastian Otoa (Genoa) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
2' Sebastian Otoa (Genoa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Genoa will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Marco Piccinini.
